curves.name: rdson_vs_drain_current_vgs_minus10V

curves.name: rdson_vs_vgs_tj_25C
curves.test_conditions: ID = -2 A, pulsed; TJ = 25 degC trace (lower of two, clearly labeled; the TJ = 125 degC companion runs above it and was not digitized). Y axis printed in mohm (100-300); converted to ohm. Cross-checks: 0.177 ohm at -VGS = 4.5 matches the RDS(ON)-ID figure's VGS = -4.5 V trace; about 0.133 ohm at -VGS = 9.5-10 vs 0.135 ohm on the VGS = -10 V trace at -ID = 2 A (within about 2 percent).

curves.name: body_diode_forward_characteristics_tj_25C
curves.test_conditions: IS - VSD figure, pulsed; TJ = 25 degC trace (right of the two; the TJ = 125 degC companion lies to its left). VGS = 0 V implied by the source-drain diode context; the figure prints no explicit gate bias. Digitized over 0.15-1.0 A where the trace is cleanly readable; above about 1 A the trace is nearly vertical and was not sampled. Note: reads about 1.07 V magnitude at 1 A, above the p. 2 table typical of 0.81 V at IS = -1 A; figure and table typical are mutually inconsistent.

extraction_notes: Source PDF SHA-256 verified: 2b51c21b8e5a59591f9ff249e11c457c24cfe73516dfc11b920f1392e599b3c0 (C7433254__CJ2309A.pdf, 6 pages, A4, Rev. - 1.2). Identity matches the batch manifest: LCSC C7433254, MPN CJ2309A, manufacturer Jiangsu Changjing Electronics Technology Co Ltd (JSCJ, www.jscj-elec.com), family mosfet, P-channel enhancement mode, SOT-23. The PDF metadata Title field reads 'Microsoft Word - CJ3420 _SOT-23_.doc' (a stale authoring artifact); the printed document is unambiguously CJ2309A on every page checked.

Extraction method: p. 1-2 tables transcribed from pdftotext -layout output and checked against a 200 dpi page render. Page 3 rasterized at 300 dpi with pdftoppm and curves digitized programmatically: plot borders and solid major gridlines located by pixel-line detection, axes calibrated on the printed tick values, traces read as dark-pixel runs per column (per row for the steep body-diode curve), with columns shifted a few pixels where a sample landed on a solid gridline. Curve points are digitized_typical_curve grade; estimated reading accuracy about 1-2 percent of full scale, and each digitized trace was cross-checked visually against panel crops.

Sign convention: P-channel device. Tabulated specs carry the datasheet's printed signs (V(BR)DSS -60 V min, VGS(th) -1/-1.9/-2.5 V, VSD typ -0.81 V max -1 V, RDS(on) conditions VGS = -10/-4.5 V, ID = -2/-1.5 A). Figure axes are printed with negative tick values (VDS, VGS, ID, IS, VSD run from 0 toward negative); curve points are recorded as plotted magnitudes with the negation carried by the axis quantity labels (-VGS, -VDS, -ID, -IS, -VSD).

Capacitances are recorded in SI farads: Ciss 380 pF = 3.8e-10 F, Coss 32 pF = 3.2e-11 F, Crss 6 pF = 6e-12 F (typicals at VDS = -30 V, VGS = 0 V, f = 1 MHz; guaranteed by design per note 3). The datasheet has no capacitance-vs-voltage figure, so no capacitance curve was digitized.

rdson_points carries both the typical and the guaranteed-maximum table values for each bias row (130/190 mohm at VGS = -10 V, ID = -2 A; 180/240 mohm at VGS = -4.5 V, ID = -1.5 A), distinguished by source_kind.

Other tabulated values without dedicated schema fields, noted here: IDSS max -1 uA (VDS = -60 V, TJ = 25 degC) and -1 mA (TJ = 125 degC); IGSS max +/-100 nA at VGS = +/-20 V; gFS typ 3.1 S (VDS = -10 V, ID = -2 A); Rg typ 17 ohm (f = 1 MHz); td(on)/tr/td(off)/tf typ 45/38/18/15 ns and Qg/Qgs/Qgd typ 12/2.5/3.9 nC (VDS = -30 V, ID = -1.5 A, VGS = -10 V, RG = 3 ohm); diode IS -1.6 A continuous, ISM -8 A pulsed. Maximum ratings: VDS -60 V, VGS +/-20 V, ID -2 A, IDM -8 A, PD 0.35 W (Ta) / 2.5 W (Tc), RthJA 357 degC/W, RthJC 50 degC/W, TJ/Tstg -55 to +150 degC.

Curves omitted deliberately: the output-characteristics VGS = -10 V and -5 V traces share one bunched label and overlap near the origin, so neither was digitized; the VGS = -2.5 V trace hugs the ID = 0 axis (about 0.14-0.18 A) where the relative reading error is large; the TJ = 125 degC companions in the RDS(ON)-VGS and IS-VSD figures; the Threshold Voltage vs TJ figure (its 25 degC end, about -1.9 V, corroborates the table typical); and the p. 4 transient thermal impedance and safe operating area figures (not DC-fit data).

Internal inconsistencies recorded as drawn: (a) the RDS(ON)-ID VGS = -10 V trace reads about 0.135 ohm at -ID = 2 A vs the table typical 0.130 ohm; (b) the IS-VSD 25 degC curve reads about 1.07 V magnitude at 1 A vs the table typical 0.81 V and maximum 1.0 V; (c) the transfer curve gives about 6.4 A at -VGS = 4 (VDS = -5 V) while the output VGS = -4 V trace reads about 7.2 A at -VDS = 4.8, a mild mutual inconsistency.
No vendor SPICE model or model pack was used; every value comes from the public datasheet PDF.
